hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/api/*.ts) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/api" && { npm run -s typecheck && npm test -s >/dev/null; } 2>&1 >&2 || { echo "api typecheck or tests failed after editing $f" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac

[ "$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = true ] && exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/api" || exit 0; git status --porcelain -- '*.ts' | grep -q . || exit 0; { npm run -s typecheck && npm test -s >/dev/null; } 2>&1 >&2 || { echo 'api typecheck or tests fail with uncommitted .ts changes - fix before finishing' >&2; exit 2; }
